entries.effect: the string AlphaChannelMode, carried with the text the newer release gives it; nothing of iOS 6 produces it, and where an application hands it to the release the release treats it as it treats any string it does not know
entries.source: the host's own CoreVideo, the symbol's address from the export trie and the __cfstring stored there; the header of iOS 16.4 for the type and the release that added the name
